s: speaker (psalmist) loves LORD
q: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

s: speaker (psalmist) is servant of LORD (son of his servant girl)
q: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl.

s: LORD is worthy of praise (by all nations and peoples)
q: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

s: LORD has loving kindness
q: For his loving kindness is great toward us.

s: LORD has faithfulness
q: The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever.

s: LORD is good
q: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

s: speaker (psalmist) is god of LORD (addressed as my God)
q: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you.

s: speaker (psalmist) takes refuge in LORD (better than trusting man)
q: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.

s: speaker (psalmist) was surrounded by nations (surrounding the speaker)
q: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.

s: speaker (psalmist) was punished by LORD (not given over to death)
q: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

s: nations (surrounding the speaker) are compared to bees (surrounding the speaker)
q: They surrounded me like bees.

s: the day (made by the LORD) is made by LORD
q: This is the day that the LORD has made.
